rationale: The candidate reads as a compact faceted wedge with a cut corner and shear, but the four views do not support a convincing long-span gymnasium. The dominant body is too sealed and the section does not clearly express a hall, daylight roof, or subordinate entry/service bar. There is essentially no public void or ground-response to activate the frontage, so the program contract fails even though the form is coherent as an abstract mass. Repair integrity is decent because the solid is continuous and not visibly self-colliding, but the language is closer to an arbitrary sculpted object than a gymnasium. The references suggest a more legible hall datum, stronger entry/court void, and a simpler roof/section rule.
